title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.
body: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.
summaryZh: 在这篇官方分析中，OpenAI首席财务官Sarah Friar深入探讨了芯片、算力基础设施、基础模型以及终端产品如何通过协同演进，以更低成本和更大规模交付高效智能，展现了AI全栈发展的经济学效应。原始信息显示：OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“The full stack behind abundant intelligence”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI CFO系统阐述了芯片、算力、模型和产品协同发展的全栈技术与经济逻辑。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
